geo_series_title: Conserved principles of spatial biology define tumor heterogeneity and immunotherapy sensitivity
geo_series_summary: Spatial transcriptomics experiments were performed on human patient pre-treatment biopsies for patients with either NSCLC or DLBCL. This was part of a larger study on pan-tumor spatial biology organization.
geo_overall_design: 18 tissue sections representing 16 pre-treatment NSCLC tumors and 2 pre-treatment DLBCL tumors were subject to spatial transcriptomics using the 10x Genomics Visium platform, followed by high throughput sequencing. Raw data not submitted due to patient privacy concerns. *************************************************************** Raw files for human/patient samples were not submitted to GEO due to concerns about submitting personally identifiable sequence data for open access. ***************************************************************
recommended_next_action: Inspect source manuscript or supplementary figures once available; current GEO pages provide sample metadata and data files but no candidate-specific validation for this LR row.
